TaskDescription: Wave 1 post-task ratings of how it felt to win or lose money with each Shared Reward partner. The PsychoPy program presented the six questions sequentially.
Instructions: Please rate how it felt to win money with this partner. The loss question substitutes the word lose for win. Use keys 1 and 3 to move on the scale and 2 to select.

trial_number.Description: One-based presentation order within the selected administration.

Levels.win: Winning money with this partner (source Trait 0)
Levels.loss: Losing money with this partner (source Trait 1)

response.Description: Selected integer rating on the original scale from -5 (negative) through 0 (neutral) to +5 (positive). An unavailable response is n/a.
